verdict.rationale: A sandbox or test environment is a fair question for a SaaS content platform with APIs, an MCP integration and agent builders, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions a sandbox, developer test tenant, or any isolated non-production environment. Snapshots and restore (egnyte-docs-11) are a recovery feature, not test isolation, and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
